name: R3a · Cell figure + dome
premise: One area at three cell sizes: L1 dome (128 u), L2 (64 u), L3 figure (32 u). Kept = after, lost = before minus after. Scores use the gate S1-S4, S6, S7 (max 12, pass >=9); dome S1 = area read; S5 tie-break. Fill = cells, of the full grid.

items.title: L1 Plate, signal lost
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 2 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 11/12 pass; S5 1 (lost shell 128 u, gutter-only gap). Dome reads "area that got smaller": orange shell over a paper dome, holds at 16 px and under blur. Mass sits low (rows 3-7). Lead. Kept 40.6%, lost 12.5%, box 100%.

items.title: L1 House, amber lost
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 10/12 pass; S5 1. Same dome on house palette; amber and acid merge under blur but the crescent survives. Kept 40.6%, lost 12.5%, box 100%.

items.title: L3 Plate, signal lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 9/12 pass; S5 1. Figure: round head, neck gap, 45° arms to a 3x3 hand on the bar, knee wedges, wheel bleeding off. Orange cap and wing bands say "was higher". Reads as a figure holding a bar more than a tuck at 64. Kept 29.9%, lost 7.0%, box 87.5%.

items.title: L1 Plate, quiet lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 2 S4 2 S6 1 S7 2 = 9/12 pass; S5 1. #5C86BC shell is calm but the loss fades at 29-40 px. Kept 40.6%, lost 12.5%, box 100%.

items.title: L3 House, amber lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 9/12 pass; S5 1. As L3 plate; amber bands read as wings at 64. Kept 29.9%, lost 7.0%, box 87.5%.

items.title: L2 Plate, signal lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 9/12 pass. Favicon 32 frame. Knee wedges taper to a spade at this level; neck gap held by hand flip. Kept 35.2%, lost 4.7%, box 87.5%.

items.title: L2 House, amber lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 1 = 8/12 fail. Spade/beetle read at 32 px. Kept 35.2%, lost 4.7%, box 87.5%.

items.title: L3 Plate, quiet lost
items.note: S1 1 S2 0 S3 1 S4 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 8/12 fail. Before bands too quiet to carry the tuck. Kept 29.9%, lost 7.0%, box 87.5%.

items.note: S1 1 S2 0 S3 2 S4 2 S6 1 S7 1 = 7/12 fail. Loss disappears below 64 px: a plain mound. Kept 40.6%, lost 12.5%, box 100%.
